house.description: Minnesota declared to be a mining-friendly state.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; declaring Minnesota to be a mining-friendly state; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 93.001.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 93.001, is amended to read:

93.001 [+MINNESOTA IS A MINING-FRIENDLY STATE; +]POLICY FOR MINERAL DEVELOPMENT.
[+Minnesota is a mining-friendly state. +]It is the policy of the state to provide for the diversification of the state's mineral economy through long-term support of mineral exploration, evaluation, environmental research, development, production, and commercialization.
bill_text.plain_text:

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 93.001, is amended to read:

93.001 MINNESOTA IS A MINING-FRIENDLY STATE; POLICY FOR MINERAL DEVELOPMENT.
Minnesota is a mining-friendly state. It is the policy of the state to provide for the diversification of the state's mineral economy through long-term support of mineral exploration, evaluation, environmental research, development, production, and commercialization.
